name: Shimo-Kitazawa
tagline: Shibuya in 8 minutes and Shinjuku in 11 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Keio and Odakyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 8 minutes to Shibuya and 34 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 36.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 12.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 36.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 29.5 m to 42.1 m, a difference of 12.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: オオゼキ 下北沢店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 15 clinics and 10 pharmacies. The nearest facility recorded as a hospital is 加藤医院, about 144 m from the station. The next nearest is 島津メディカルクリニック, about 210 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Keio Inokashira Line run through it. Odakyu Odawara Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (Keio runs 1 line and Odakyu runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which includes this station. Keio Inokashira Line runs at 125% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池ノ上→駒場東大前, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shimo-Kitazawa, but Ikenoue is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: 578 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shimo-Kitazawa. One-room rents run about ¥19,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Shindaita is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Shimo-Kitazawa is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: 614 m away in a straight line. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shimo-Kitazawa.

noiseSources: The nearest big road is 鮫洲大山線, 498 m away, so little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
